content.text:
cd /workspace && git commit -m "refactor: enforce supabase-only production event flow
- eventServiceClient.js: USE_DIRECT_API_FALLBACK=false, Supabase-only as primary
- api-server.cjs: /events redirects to /debug-direct-events (deprecated)
- api-server.cjs: /supabase-events adds metadata (data_source, ingestion_stats)
- api-server.cjs: /health includes ingestion freshness (events_24h, active_sources)
- App.js: Uses fetchEventsFromSupabase (Supabase-only in production)
- package.json: Adds @supabase/supabase-js and axios dependencies
Production flow: sources -> ingestion -> normalizer -> Supabase -> /supabase-events -> App.js
Debug flow (isolated): /debug-direct-events (for development only)"
[main 20274b99] refactor: enforce supabase-only production event flow
 4 files changed, 607 insertions(+), 59 deletions(-)
